items.followUp: Differentiate between an HTML tag and an HTML attribute.

rubric.why: An anchor is the HTML tag used to create a link.
rubric.description: Identifies the anchor as an HTML tag.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for identifying the anchor as the HTML tag used to create a link.

rubric.why: A hyperlink is the clickable link that leads to another page or resource.
rubric.description: Explains what a hyperlink is or where it leads.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for describing a hyperlink as a clickable link or as a link to another webpage or resource.

modelAnswer: The anchor tag (<a>) is the HTML tag used to create a link.
A hyperlink is the clickable link that takes the user to another webpage or resource.

rubric.why: Volatile memory loses its stored data when power is turned off.
rubric.description: States what happens to volatile memory when power is removed.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that volatile memory loses its data when the power is turned off.

rubric.why: Non-volatile memory retains its data even when power is turned off.
rubric.description: States what happens to non-volatile memory when power is removed.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that non-volatile memory retains its data when the power is turned off.

modelAnswer: Volatile memory loses its data when the power is turned off.
Non-volatile memory retains its data even when the power is turned off.
